title: Portfolio8 Exact‑LP SA‑LP (8×60s + 480s polish; saves freeze)
abstract: Runs 8 exact‑accept SA‑LP restarts (60s each) from hex seeds, selects the best by Σr, then applies a 480s exact‑accept polish. Saves centers/radii to storage/noesis/pack/runs for reproducibility. Deterministic seed list.

original_submission.content:
import numpy as np, sys
sys.path.append('storage/noesis/pack')
import sa_lp_exact as M

def construct_packing():
    seeds = [20251021, 20251022, 20251023, 20251024, 20251025, 20251026, 20251027, 20251028]
    centers, radii, score = M.run_exact_portfolio(seeds=seeds, per_run=60.0, polish=480.0, save=True)
    # validity
    assert centers.shape == (26,2)
    assert radii.shape == (26,)
    assert np.all(radii > 0)
    x, y = centers[:,0], centers[:,1]
    b = np.minimum.reduce([x, 1-x, y, 1-y])
    assert np.all(radii <= b + 1e-9)
    return centers, radii
